headline: Dhaka rocked by crude bomb blasts and bus fires across the city
summary: Multiple explosions at Dhaka University and CID headquarters, alongside torched buses in Bhatara, Dhamrai, and Savar, have sparked police investigations into sabotage.
details: Criminals exploded crude bombs in several areas of Dhaka, including inside Dhaka University and the Criminal Investigation Department (CID) headquarters, and torched three buses in Bhatara, Dhamrai, and Savar.

At Dhaka University, a series of explosions rocked at least six different locations, including the TSC intersection, Senate Building, and Nilkhet Gate. Students caught three suspects—Rezaul Karim, Sohel Rana, and Nazmus Saad—and handed them over to police.

A crude bomb was hurled from the Moghbazar-Mouchak Flyover into the CID headquarters compound in Malibagh, exploding near a Special Branch (SB) vehicle. Another blast occurred in front of Sony Cinema Hall in Mirpur-1.
Three buses were set ablaze: a Jalsiri Cantonment School bus in Bhatara, a D-Link Paribahan bus in Dhamrai, and a Savar Paribahan bus on the Dhaka-Aricha highway.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) stated that these attacks were aimed at creating public panic. Police suspect a particular group is deliberately carrying out sabotage and have arrested several people, including members of banned organisations.

Law enforcement has strengthened intelligence-led operations, increased police deployment, and introduced mobile patrols to ensure public safety. Detectives are also analyzing CCTV footage to identify suspects.

headline_marked: Dhaka Tribune [[journalists held hostage and tortured]] by Tongi drug gang
headline: Dhaka Tribune journalists held hostage and tortured by Tongi drug gang
summary: Reporters were reportedly held at gunpoint and assaulted by a gang operating within a notorious drug empire in Tongi.
details: Journalists from the Dhaka Tribune were allegedly held hostage and tortured at gunpoint by a drug gang in Tongi.
The attack occurred as the reporters were investigating a drug empire that continues to operate in the area despite repeated law enforcement crackdowns.
The gang members used weapons to intimidate and assault the journalists during the ordeal.
This incident highlights the extreme risks faced by media professionals reporting on organized crime and drug trafficking in the region.
